game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Ice Mill, a frozen mill wheel: the frost mage must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Keyword Switchboard: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Mill: a frozen mill wheel
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Mill, repeat each round: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the wires value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the wall banner using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the wall banner is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Keyword Switchboard
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Keyword Switchboard' (Week 6 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ice Mill'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wires changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Ice Mill.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 15.
